edges.quote: There is wheelchair access to the visitor center at General Grant National Memorial. The ramp begins just north of the overlook pavilion along the sidewalk on the southbound side of Riverside Drive.

review.source: An official website of the United States government Here's how you know Skip to global NPS navigation Skip to this park navigation Skip to the main content Skip to this park information section Skip to the footer section National Park Service Search Open Menu General Grant National Memorial Info Alerts Maps Calendar Fees Accessibility There is wheelchair access to the visitor center at General Grant National Memorial. The ramp begins just north of the overlook pavilion along the sidewalk on the southbound side of Riverside Drive. However, the mausoleum is not wheelchair accessible. There are 25 paved steps leading to the entrance of the mausoleum and 20 marble steps inside leading downstairs into the crypt. Last updated: May 30, 2025 Was this page helpful?
